away.summary: The Ducks (4-6-0) are playing their fourth game in six nights and the final game of a four-game road trip, having lost five straight in regulation, including a 4-1 loss to the Devils on Thursday. Their projected lineup lists Lukas Dostal as the starting goalie ahead of Ville Husso, with Judd Caulfield, Jeff Malott, and Travis Mitchell scratched.

home.summary: The Flyers (3-6-3) are home after a 3-1 win in Buffalo on Wednesday, their third straight victory. Joseph Woll is projected to start in goal over Dan Vladar, who made 27 saves in the Sabres win. Scratched players include Hunter McDonald, Garrett Wilson, David Jiricek, and Michael Bunting.
